name: zoho-mcp
description: Read and write Zoho Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Tasks, Notes, Bookmarks and Resource Booking. Sending email is off by default.
long_description:
Exposes a Zoho account as 42 MCP tools, covering Mail, Calendar, Contacts, and Zoho Mail's Tasks, Notes, Bookmarks and Groups, plus Calendar's Resource Booking.

Runs locally over stdio: no listening socket, no hosted endpoint, and no third-party relay. The only outbound calls are to Zoho's own REST APIs, with one exception you control: if you tick "Check for new versions of this extension", `check_for_updates` asks GitHub's public releases API which version is current. That setting is off when you install it, and nothing about your account is sent when it is on.

Mail composition is draft-first. `create_draft`, `reply_draft` and `forward_draft` always work and always save to Drafts; `send_email` saves to Drafts too, and only delivers if you tick "Let the assistant send email without your review" in this extension's settings. That setting is off when you install it. There is no send-a-reply or send-a-forward tool at any setting, because both carry incoming mail and incoming mail is untrusted input.

Every date and time is returned already converted to the mailbox's own local offset, fetched live rather than stored, so no caller has to get a timezone conversion right.

After installing, run the `authenticate` tool once to authorize access. It opens Zoho's own consent page in your browser; the resulting token is stored in your OS credential store, never in this conversation or in a file.

zoho_client_id.title: Zoho Client ID
zoho_client_id.description: From the Server-based Application you registered at https://accounts.zoho.com/developerconsole with redirect URI http://localhost:8765/callback

zoho_client_secret.title: Zoho Client Secret
zoho_client_secret.description: The client secret for that same Zoho API Console application. Stored in your OS credential store.

zoho_oauth_callback_port.title: OAuth Callback Port
zoho_oauth_callback_port.description: Local port the one-time authorization redirect listens on. Must match the redirect URI you registered. Only used while authorizing.

zoho_strip_invisible_chars.title: Strip invisible padding characters from email bodies
zoho_strip_invisible_chars.description: Some marketing email pads its preview text with invisible Unicode. Turn this on to remove it when reading a message. Never touches zero-width joiners, which carry real meaning in emoji and several scripts.

zoho_allow_auto_send.title: Let the assistant send email without your review
zoho_allow_auto_send.description: Off by default. Left off, asking the assistant to send mail saves it to Drafts instead, for you to review and send yourself — nothing can leave your account. Turn this on only if you want an assistant able to deliver mail to real people without you seeing it first; email you receive is untrusted input, and a message in your mailbox can contain text aimed at talking an assistant into sending something. Replies and forwards stop at Drafts either way.

zoho_check_for_updates.title: Check for new versions of this extension
zoho_check_for_updates.description: Off by default. Turn this on to let the check_for_updates tool ask GitHub's public releases API whether a newer version has been published. It is the only thing here that contacts a host other than Zoho. Nothing about your account, mail or settings is sent — the request asks for a version number and nothing else. Updates are never installed for you; you are told where to download the new bundle.
